outcome: Characteristics of women undergoing obstetric fistula repair
cohort: 65 Rwandan women undergoing surgical correction of obstetric fistula
finding: Women who underwent cesarean delivery were more likely to have a cervicovesical or uterovesical fistula compared to those who had a vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was performed in 48% of the women and was associated with a higher incidence of fistulas involving the uterus or cervix.
